name: creative-model-bridge
description: Route creative writing requests through a bundled, auditable one-shot Python bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Use configured creative models through a transparent bundled CLI.
interface.longDescription: Builds deterministic prompts from the requested task and supplied materials, sends one streaming OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions request, and returns reasoning and generated output verbatim as one JSON result.
defaultPrompt: Generate a draft using the exact model I name.
Revise this creative work while preserving the supplied material.
